BiblicalUsage: Shashak was a Benjamite, son of Beriah and father of Iphedeiah and Penuel, named in the genealogy of Benjamin. His name means longing, and his sons are named after him in the lists.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the longing in his name is the story of every exile. Shashak's sons are counted, and I hold that God counts the longing ones.
